It is submitted by the learned Advocate for the  State respondents that on the basis of the order dated 12th July, 2023, the respondents deposited a demand draft for a sum of Rs.3,09,628/- deducting the amount paid to the petitioners already for 108 months.
The said amount has been paid before the learned Registrar General, High Court, Calcutta.
The report and the photostat copy of the demand draft be kept with the record.

Having heard the learned Advocate for the petitioners and the learned Advocate for the State respondents, it is ascertained that the learned Counsels for both the parties have agreed that the premises in question are required to be acquired under the provision of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: Learned Advocate for the State respondents submits and it is within the knowledge of this Court that 2013 Act has not been given effect to in the State of West Bengal on the ground that the Rules under the Act of 2013 have not been framed as yet.
On being asked, it is submitted by the learned Advocate for the respondents that he will communicate the time period, that is required for framing the Rules under 2013 Act.
In view of such circumstances, the instant writ petition placed listed for further hearing on 6 th September, 2023.

The learned Advocate for the State respondents is requested to intimate this Court the time limit within which the rules under 2013 Act can be framed by the State Government to give effect to the 2013 Act.
This Court hopes and trusts that the time limit shall be reasonable so that the Court can accept the proposal submitted by the State Government in the case.

(Bibek Chaudhuri, J.)
